prompt:
Photorealistic rear-view portrait of one adult person.

Show the back of the head and upper-to-full torso as required
by the target hair-length category.

The person has naturally wavy hair with moderate, realistic
hair density and natural individual strands.

Hair color is medium neutral brown and must remain consistent
across the dataset.

Hair texture is naturally wavy with moderate wave definition.

Natural human anatomy.

Natural head and neck proportions.

Natural shoulder and back proportions.

Neutral natural posture.

Both shoulders should be visible whenever required by the
target composition.

Simple uncluttered indoor background.

Natural photographic lighting.

Realistic individual hair strands.

Realistic hair volume.

Realistic hair silhouette.

Photorealistic high-detail photography.

The hairstyle must look physically attached to the person's
head and follow realistic hair growth and gravity.

The hair endpoint must be visually observable.

The anatomical landmarks needed to judge hair length must be
clearly visible.

Do not crop the relevant anatomical landmarks.

Do not hide the hair endpoint behind clothing.

Do not allow clothing to obscure the hair endpoint.

Do not use an extreme camera angle.

Do not create an illustration or painting.

Do not include text, labels, arrows, measurement lines,
diagrams, or annotations.


============================================================
TARGET HAIR-LENGTH CATEGORY
============================================================

Target taxonomy category:

SHOULDER

Operational anatomical landmark:

SHOULDER_LEVEL

Haircut structure:

SHOULDER_LENGTH_LOB

Required haircut structure:

long bob / lob structure with the main perimeter terminating around shoulder level

============================================================
ANATOMICAL ENDPOINT CONSTRAINT
============================================================

The majority of the hair ends must terminate at approximately the same vertical level as the shoulders.

The hair endpoint is the primary visual feature that must
distinguish this category.

The endpoint must be clearly visible.

Do not interpret the category from hairstyle terminology alone.

The actual physical relationship between the hair endpoint
and the person's anatomy must satisfy the definition.

============================================================
TAXONOMY DEFINITION
============================================================

Hair terminates approximately at the shoulder line, with the ends visually aligned with the shoulders.

============================================================
VISUAL PROMPT CONSTRAINT
============================================================

hair ends align approximately exactly with the shoulder line; the endpoints visibly overlap the shoulder-level region

============================================================
CAMERA / COMPOSITION
============================================================

show the full head, neck, both shoulders, and upper torso; the shoulder line must be clearly visible

The composition must provide enough anatomical context for
an independent human evaluator to determine the target
category from the image alone.

============================================================
CONTROLLED VARIABLES
============================================================

Keep the following approximately constant across all cases:

- adult person
- medium neutral brown hair
- naturally wavy texture
- moderate realistic density
- natural photographic lighting
- simple indoor background
- rear-view orientation

Only the target hair length, haircut structure, endpoint
relationship, and required framing should change.

============================================================
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
============================================================



illustration,
painting,
cartoon,
anime,
fantasy,
multiple people,
duplicate person,

cropped head,
cropped hair,
cropped hair endpoint,
cropped shoulders,

hair hidden behind clothing,
hair endpoint hidden,

hair fused with clothing,
hair fused with background,

unrealistic hair,
floating hair,
detached hair,
plastic hair,
synthetic-looking hair,

extreme camera angle,
extreme close-up,

blurred hair,
blurred anatomical landmarks,

distorted anatomy,
deformed shoulders,
deformed neck,

text,
caption,
label,
arrow,
measurement line,
diagram


Do not add text, labels, arrows, measurement lines,
diagrams, or annotations to the image.
